fine_lines.title: prefix vs suffix
fine_lines.explanation_ar: السابقة تأتي في أول الكلمة وتغيّر المعنى غالبًا (do → redo). اللاحقة تأتي في آخر الكلمة وتغيّر وظيفتها النحوية أو نوعها (argue → argument).
fine_lines.explanation_en: A prefix goes at the start and usually changes the meaning (do → redo). A suffix goes at the end and changes the grammar or the word class (argue → argument).

fine_lines.title: -ance vs -ence
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما يصنع أسماء، ولا توجد قاعدة سهلة لاختيار الإملاء لأنهما من اللاتينية؛ احفظ كل كلمة: importance, reverence.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both make nouns. There's no easy spelling rule (they come from Latin), so learn each word: importance, reverence.

examples.sentence: They showed reverence for their teacher.

expressions.example: Don't give up. Yes, you can do it!

expressions.meaning_en: You know more, so I will follow your decision.
expressions.example: You're the expert, so I will defer to you.

grammar.title: Grammar suffixes: -s, -ed, -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: هذه اللواحق تغيّر الوظيفة النحوية لا المعنى: -s للغائب المفرد في المضارع (he goes)، -ed للماضي (watched)، -ing للمستمر أو الصفة أو الاسم (working, a swimming pool, cooking).
grammar.explanation_en: These suffixes change grammar, not meaning: -s for third person singular present (he goes), -ed for the past (watched), -ing for continuous, adjective or noun (working, a swimming pool, cooking).

grammar.title: -ment makes nouns (action or process)
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف ment إلى فعل لنصنع اسمًا يدل على الفعل أو العملية: govern → government, argue → argument, encourage → encouragement, improve → improvement.
grammar.explanation_en: Add -ment to a verb to make a noun for an action or process: govern → government, argue → argument, encourage → encouragement, improve → improvement.
examples: The government built a new hospital.

grammar.title: -ance / -ence makes nouns (state or quality)
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف ance أو ence لنصنع اسمًا يدل على حالة أو صفة: revere → reverence, defer → deference.
grammar.explanation_en: Add -ance or -ence to make a noun for a state or quality: revere → reverence, defer → deference.
examples: In deference to his age, we let him go first.

grammar.title: -able / -ible makes adjectives (worthy of / good for)
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف able أو ible لنصنع صفة بمعنى "يستحق" أو "صالح لـ": love → lovable (يستحق الحب)، enjoy → enjoyable (ممتع).
grammar.explanation_en: Add -able or -ible to make an adjective meaning "worthy of" or "good for": love → lovable, enjoy → enjoyable.

grammar.title: -er = a person who does something
grammar.explanation_ar: اللاحقة er تدل غالبًا على الشخص الذي يقوم بالفعل: law → lawyer، teach → teacher.
grammar.explanation_en: The suffix -er often means a person who does something: law → lawyer, teach → teacher.

questions.question: A suffix goes ___ a word.
questions.explanation_en: A suffix goes at the end.

questions.question: Which suffix makes a noun from "argue"?
"Thank you for your ___." (words that gave me confidence)
Which word has a grammar suffix that does NOT change the word class?
questions.explanation_ar: goes: لاحقة s نحوية تبقى فعلًا.
questions.explanation_en: "Goes": the -s is a grammar suffix; it stays a verb.

questions.question: "I will ___ to you. You know more than me."
questions.explanation_en: We need a verb: defer to.
